extracted.name: Stewed Tomatoes (Gobbledygook)
extracted.description: Canned tomatoes are baked with stale bread, butter, and sugar in this southern-style side dish.
ingredient_lines: 1 (28 ounce) can whole peeled tomatoes, with liquid
3 slices stale bread, torn into pieces
instruction_lines: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 1 1/2 quart baking dish.
Stir the tomatoes, bread, sugar, butter, salt, and pepper in a bowl; pour into the prepared dish.
Bake until hot and the tomatoes are tender, about 45 minutes.
